testcase.name: Scenario: Import settings with edits staged on two ribbon targets: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1542:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Import settings with edits staged on two ribbon targets ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows All Commands and initially empty Part Tools and Part Manage targets ✔ And a settings file contains 2D Sketches on Part Tools and no custom entries for Part Manage ✔ And 3D Annotations is staged on Part Tools ✔ And 2D Sketches is staged on Part Manage ✔ And Part Manage is the selected target ✔ When the user imports the settings file ✔ Then the import chooser closes ✔ And the Part Manage target list is empty ✔ And Part Manage shows a pending-change marker ✔ When the user selects the Part Tools target ✔ Then the target contains 2D Sketches with Large and Text unchecked ✔ And 3D Annotations is available in the source list ✔ And Part Tools shows a pending-change marker ✔ When the user clicks Cancel in the customization dialog ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
